name: app.pixelpattern/patterns
title: Pixel Pattern craft pattern tools
description: Match colors to Perler, Hama, Artkal beads and DMC floss; pattern sizes, bead counts and prices.

tools.name: match_color
tools.description: Nearest Perler, Hama and Artkal bead and DMC floss color (or Minecraft block, PICO-8, Game Boy) to a hex or RGB color, by CIEDE2000, with codes, names and close alternatives.

palettes.description: Palettes to search (default perler, hama, artkal, dmc). Any of: perler, hama, artkal, dmc, minecraft, minecraftWool, pico8, gameboy

alternatives.description: How many next-closest colors to add per palette (0–5)

tools.name: pattern_size
tools.description: Number of beads, stitches, squares or blocks for a grid size and craft, the finished size in cm and inches, pegboards needed (fuse beads) and stacks (Minecraft).

craft.description: beads (Perler/Hama/Artkal fuse beads), stitch (cross stitch, DMC), c2c (C2C crochet), crochet (tapestry crochet), minecraft (blocks) or pixel (pixel art)

width.description: Cells across (8–200), e.g. 29 for one Perler pegboard

height.description: Cells down. Leave out to use the photo proportions (photo_aspect_ratio) or a square grid

photo_aspect_ratio.description: Photo width ÷ height (e.g. 1.5 for a 3:2 landscape); the height follows it like in the tool

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Every craft the pattern maker supports with its palettes (brand and color count), size presets, default color count, cell size and grid and color limits.

tools.name: pattern_prices
tools.description: Exact prices of the printable PDF patterns (per photo and the 3-photo pack), what is free, the re-download period and the refund policy.

tools.name: photo_to_pattern_steps
tools.description: Steps to turn a photo into a bead, cross stitch, crochet, Minecraft or pixel art pattern, with a link to the pattern maker. This server can't receive photos; the link opens the browser tool.

craft.description: beads (Perler/Hama/Artkal fuse beads), stitch (cross stitch, DMC), c2c (C2C crochet), crochet (tapestry crochet), minecraft (blocks) or pixel (pixel art)
